strings.x.tip.close: Close window (keeps watching from the menu bar)
strings.x.waitTip: How long to wait after the AI goes quiet
strings.x.tapToggle: Tap to turn on or off
strings.x.chAwakeTip: Keeps the Mac awake while AI works
strings.x.chNetTip: Keeps the Mac awake during heavy network use
strings.x.chAwayTip: Sleeps when the AI is idle and nobody uses the Mac
strings.x.chDeadlineTip: Sleeps or shuts down at a set time
strings.x.chLockTip: Locks the Mac if you step away while it is kept awake
strings.x.chPushTip: Sends finish and sleep alerts to your phone
strings.x.targetsIntro: If any app you turned on is working, the Mac stays awake. When all are done, your chosen action runs.
strings.x.pickHint: Pick one, then press Add. Double-clicking works too.
strings.x.sAwakeHint: The Mac will not sleep while AI works
strings.x.displayHint: If off, only the screen turns off and the Mac keeps working
strings.x.sNetHint: Stays awake during heavy network use
strings.x.sAfterHint: Choose the action and wait time on the main screen
strings.x.user: Wait while I am using the Mac
strings.x.userHint: Will not run while the keyboard or mouse is in use
strings.x.awayHint: Counts only while the AI is idle and there is no input. Waits if the Mac is busy (CPU 25% or more).
strings.x.dailyHint: Keeps the Mac from staying on until morning
strings.x.dlWait: If AI is working, wait until it finishes
strings.x.dlWaitHint: Skipped for the day if not done within 4 hours
strings.x.quietHint: No automatic shutdown during these hours
strings.x.lockScreen: Turn off the screen when locking
strings.x.pushHint: Get finish and sleep alerts on your phone
strings.x.topicHint: Subscribe to this topic in the ntfy app. Anyone who knows the name can read it, so make it hard to guess.
strings.x.detectHint: How AI Watchdog decides an AI is working
strings.x.cpuTh: CPU use that counts as working
strings.x.cpuHint: If a working AI shows as Idle in the list, lower the CPU value.
strings.x.notifyHint: Shows how long it worked and what happens next
strings.x.metersHint: Shows CPU, memory, GPU, and network on the main screen
strings.x.startupHint: Starts quietly in the menu bar
strings.lang.label: Language
strings.lang.hint: Add a file to the lang folder to add a language
strings.c.already: AI Watchdog is already running. Open it from the menu bar icon.
strings.tray.hidden: Still watching from the menu bar. Choose Quit from the icon menu to stop.
strings.notice.away: If the Mac is not used for {0} min, {1}.
strings.away.hint: When the AI is idle and the Mac is unused for {0} min, {1}
strings.foot.deadlineWait: Past the set time. As soon as the AI finishes, {0}.
strings.hero.pendingDesc: To keep using the Mac, press Cancel or Esc.
strings.hero.workingDesc: Keeping the Mac awake while {0} works.
strings.hero.noHold: Keep-awake is off, so the Mac may sleep as usual.
strings.hero.waitNet: Waiting for the download to finish.
strings.hero.waitUser: You are using the Mac, so it is waiting. The countdown restarts when you stop.
strings.hero.downloadDesc: Keeping the Mac awake during heavy network use.
strings.hero.noTargetsDesc: Turn on apps to watch under Manage.
strings.hero.offDesc: Start one and it will be watched automatically.
strings.rest.busy: The Mac is busy (CPU {0:0}%), so sleep is on hold.
strings.rest.auto.1: When the AI finishes, the screen will turn off.
strings.rest.auto.2: When the AI finishes, sleep will be scheduled.
strings.rest.auto.3: When the AI finishes, shutdown will be scheduled.
strings.rest.windows: The Mac follows your macOS sleep settings.
strings.agent.empty: No apps to watch. Turn some on under Manage.
strings.mode.tip:
By usage: counts as working only while it uses CPU.
While open: counts as working the whole time it runs.
Click to switch.
strings.pick.first: Pick an app from the list first.
strings.err.startup: Could not change the startup setting: {0}
strings.tip.noGpu: Cannot read GPU usage on this Mac
strings.push.reason.away: The Mac has not been used for a while
strings.push.test: Alerts work. You will be notified here when work finishes.
strings.push.failed: Could not send. Check the topic name and your internet connection.
strings.err.noLang: The lang folder was not found, so English is shown.
strings.x.tgSteps:
1. In Telegram, send /newbot to @BotFather to create a bot, then paste the token below.
2. Open a chat with your new bot and send it any message.
3. Press Find and the chat ID is filled in.
strings.x.tgSecure: The token is stored in your macOS Keychain.
strings.tg.noMessage: No messages to the bot yet. Send it any message in Telegram, then press Find again.
strings.tg.findFailed: Could not look it up. Check the bot token and your internet connection.
strings.push.failedTg: Could not send. Check the bot token, chat ID, and your internet connection.
strings.tg.err.token: The bot token is not valid. Paste the whole token from @BotFather again (digits:letters).
strings.tg.err.chat: Chat not found. Send /start to your bot, then press Find again.
strings.tg.err.blocked: The bot cannot message you. Send /start to the bot in Telegram, and unblock it if you blocked it.
strings.tg.err.network: Could not reach the Telegram server. Telegram may be blocked on work or school networks.
strings.fan.applied.fixed: Fans are running at a fixed speed.
strings.fan.autoHint: macOS picks the speed. This is the normal setting.
strings.fan.safe: If AI Watchdog quits, the fans go back to automatic within 15 seconds.
strings.fan.helperTitle: Changing fan speed needs a helper
strings.fan.helperDesc: macOS only lets administrators change the fans. Install a small helper once with your password, and after that changes apply right away. You can remove it any time in Settings.
strings.fan.outdated: AI Watchdog was updated, so the helper needs reinstalling.
strings.fan.unsupported: This Mac doesn't allow apps to change fan speed. Speeds and temperatures are shown only.
strings.fan.none: This Mac has no fans. Temperatures are shown only.
strings.fan.helperNameHint: A small background program that sets fan speed. Removing it returns the fans to automatic.
strings.tok.hint: Counted from Claude Code logs on this Mac (~/.claude). Costs use list API prices, so they differ from a subscription.
strings.tok.empty: No Claude Code logs yet. Usage appears here after you use Claude Code.
